stem.text: A parachutist falls vertically from rest at time $t = 0$ from a hot-air balloon. She falls for some distance before opening her parachute.
Which graph best shows the variation with time $t$ of the speed $v$ of the parachutist?

A.alt: Graph of v against t. A curve rises from the origin, becomes flat, then drops steeply and levels off close to the t axis.

B.alt: Graph of v against t. A straight rising line from the origin curves into a flat section, then a curve falls and levels off close to the t axis.

C.alt: Graph of v against t. A flat section, then a curve, a sloped flat section, a steep straight fall and a levelling-off curve to the t axis.

D.alt: Graph of v against t. A curve falls from the v axis to a flat section, then a steep fall to a lower flat section, then a vertical drop to the t axis.
